TD chance is the probability of 1+ red-zone touchdown, from expected red-zone TDs a game (his weighted share of team red-zone work × team trips × opponent TD rate allowed) — never a scaled index. Share weights targets 1.00 and carries 0.75, and is bar-scaled within position across the full slate. PRIME ≥40%, LIVE ≥28%, FRINGE ≥18%. Green always favours the player, including the defense column — a high TD rate allowed reads green. Quarterback rows are rushing touchdowns only. Rates are full-season 2025 baselines.
